title: The Perceptron: A Probabilistic Model for Information Storage and Organization in the Brain
summary: Frank Rosenblatt published The Perceptron: A Probabilistic Model for Information Storage and Organization in the Brain in Psychological Review, volume 65, issue 6, pages 386–408, in November 1958. The paper presents a theory for a hypothetical nervous system called a perceptron.
significance: A documented 1958 primary-source milestone presenting Rosenblatt's perceptron theory and a statistical model of learning and recognition in the early history of neural-network research.
